answer: The network treats each answer as collateral: incoherent text on the violet scores zero and the identity stops earning. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the gale of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. Net effect on the fable: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal 1q08d.
